proposal.reason: Main change is review-routing correctness and invitation lifecycle in workflow automation: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds run-number staleness protection before saving/inviting, adjusts required-reviewer/rerequest logic, and handles 422 withdrawal as warning-only while preserving invite state. Supporting ownership stays in workflow via .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py and commit_message_squash.py PR-number normalization/identify mode plus .github/workflows/review-gate.yml and review-squash-preview.yml canonical per-PR concurrency wiring; .github/skills/pccl-review-assignment/modules.json only updates catalog/classification policy, which workflow explicitly owns.
